dataset.name: imagenette
dataset.class_count_discrepancy_resolution: In official FastAI Imagenette-v2, the validation set is a 70/30 split of ImageNet-1K source images. Because source classes have varying image counts, the 30% validation partition contains slightly variable per-class counts totaling 3,925 (mean 392.5). The earlier mention of '393 per class' was an informal rounded average (3,925 / 10 = 392.5 ~ 393), whereas the true exact empirical validation counts are [387, 395, 357, 386, 409, 394, 389, 419, 399, 390].
dataset.assumptions: Rows 0-9468 correspond to the official FastAI training split sorted by class folder; rows 9469-13393 correspond to the official FastAI validation split sorted by class folder. Verified via exact per-class counts, boundary transition from class 9 (row 9468) to class 0 (row 9469), and zero image hash collisions between splits.

paired_comparison_method: Cluster paired bootstrap resampling at original-image level preserving all condition observations per image.
